name: Text Generation Pattern
description: Basic AI text generation pattern (Start -> AI -> End)
explanation:
Basic pattern for AI text generation.

Key settings:
- outputFormat: 'text' (not json)
- No JSON Schema needed
- temperature: 0.7 for creative responses
- includeChatHistory: true for conversational context
- showTools: true (can connect tools if needed)

Use cases:
- Summarizing documents
- Generating explanations
- Conversational responses
- Content drafts

The systemMessage guides the AI's writing style.
